answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), or its platform-equivalent measurement, with verification rooted in genuine Intel SGX or AMD SEV hardware. A copied virtual machine may reproduce software state but cannot forge the platform-bound attestation key, so cloning an identity requires purchasing and provisioning physical silicon. The reef registry, beacon challenge, and umber audit trail expose replayed or duplicate claims.
